This thread and its content are a pre-CBT non-final initial version for preliminary review, potentially unrelated to the final version, and can/will be changed/edited (including additions and deletions) at any time.
The content of the thread can/will be changed/edited (including additions and deletions) at any time.

Yellow text indicates points that are "new" and have not been described before (i.e. what has changed since the last project).

CONCEPT:

  • Server client - 2.2.3.2
  • Server protection - Cerberus
  • 3 phases with a maximum level - 65 (Phase 1 up to level 50, Phase 2 up to level 55, Phase 3 up to level 65).
    • The concept of "Stages", which is a mini-phase every two weeks.
      • We have heard your positive and not-so-positive feedback regarding stage-based development. The main "pro" points were good drop rates in dungeons, bosses, and quests updated by stages. The "con" points were the cascade devaluation of current equipment.
      • Based on your feedback, we have tried to adapt the stage-based content in such a way as to mitigate these downsides while highlighting the upsides. Currently, the concept of stages is mostly used for the gradation of quest rewards, content, and BD keys introduction, rather than "hard limits" as it was in Stage Era.
      • For example, Leon weapons are available from the first stage, however, obtaining them is very difficult, and only a few will be able to craft them. As the stages progress, obtaining them will become slightly easier, as on any server without stages, but there won't be such price collapses as there were last time.
  • "Guild brawl" [More details]- a unique system on a permanent basis, with the bonus for guild events.
  • Guild store for buying in-game items with guild points. [More details]
  • Guild Development System with individual leveling of guild effects and skills.
    [More details]
    • Added new "mini-Pit Bosses" (Guild PB) with unique loot "guild skill capsules" that temporary increase stats for all guild characters.
  • Added many achievements "FIRST ON CERBERUS", completing which allows you to receive Cash Shop rewards. [More details]
  • Unique Easter Egg quest with 2,000,000 Cash Shop reward. [More details]
  • Updated automatic online web-auction for selling characters, items, and resources for shop points, including to other races. [More details]
  • Ability to withdraw Cash Shop > real money. [More details]

RATES:

  • Premium does not give bonuses to experience gain. Premium gives Auto-Loot* medal + +1 speed sword. [More details]
    *The Auto-Loot medal does not work for turrets below level 50 (during the first week - up to 45).
  • Experience - "Dynamic" leveling rates + Catching-up System [More details ]
  • Animus Experience: x6
  • PT/Skills: x5
  • Force: x5
  • Loot drop: x2
  • Loot pick-up speed: x2 (Auto-Loot with Premium) + Drop-level system [More details]

CLASS AND RACE SKILL CHANGES:

General changes (regardless of race):
  • Cross-classes are available.
  • Warrior expert skill Aid Stretching (extending duration of skill buffs) moved to basic skill.
  • Warrior basic buffs Rage and Range combined into 1 buff.
  • Ranger expert buffs Wide Range and Evasion combined into 1 buff.
  • Buff Concession:
    • Buff effect Concession has been reduced by 2 times for characters with basic Mage class. I.e., on mage tanks, the Concession buff gives half as much (Lv7 - 10%);
    • Buff effect Concession has been increased by 1.25 times for characters with basic Warrior class. I.e., on warriors, the Concession buff gives a quarter more (Lv7 - 25%).
  • Magic debuffs Weakness and Vulnerability can only be used on characters.
  • Magic debuff Enfeeblement effect decreased on levels 1-5.
  • Increased duration of almost all class buffs to 400 seconds.
  • Reduced the cooldown of Melee Bash Explosion skill to 16 seconds.
  • Added new skill Second Wind to all Warrior 2nd classes. When used, it removes all negative debuffs from the character.
  • Unique PrecisionAccuracy, accuracy, and dodge module. [More details]
  • Reworked dodge and accuracy:
    • Increased dodge at the seventh level of the Evasion buff from 30 to 40;
    • Increased dodge in all dodge potions by +10;
    • Increased dodge in all equipment sets, not counting the officer (council) set, by +5;
    • Reduced the amount of PrecisionAccuracy in most class buffs (for exact values, see racial changes below);
    • Reduced the amount of PrecisionAccuracy in Cora magic elite buff Acuity by 3 times (for example, on level seven it was 30, now it is 10);
    • Reduced the amount of dodge in Bellato magic elite buff Agility by 3 times (for example, on level seven it was 30, now it is 10);
    • Reduced the amount of dodge in over-perf elemental jewelry. Was [atk/doj] - 26/21 27/22 28/23 29/24 30/25, became - 26/20 27/21 28/21 29/22 30/22).

  • PrecisionAccuracy of the attacking character - [ +6 gloves 105 + PrecisionAccuracy potion 30 + expert PrecisionAccuracy buff 30 ]

  • All races have 2 unique generators, increasing the character's strength. Generators have different effects and can be purchased with PVP points and Hunting Points (separately).
  • Increased survivability of level 50+ turrets.
  • Changed the mechanics of critical hit from mass attacks (works only on players; changes do not apply to monsters). Now anti-crit is calculated for each individual player hit by the mass attack. Previously, anti-crit was projected from the primary target.
  • Notable "non-skill" changes:
    • Added and implemented a new character development system - "Relics". [More details *link*]
      • Added the ability to upgrade relics.
        To put it simply, relics are unique power-ups that permanently increase character stats, stack with each other, and do not take up inventory space. Relics can be obtained in various ways.
    • Removed "system" miss on monsters. Previously, any direct attack had a 5% chance to miss a monster, but this function has been disabled.
    • Added a technical macro module for auto cure potions. Allows auto-use of cure potions in a macro. There is also a configurable filter for which debuffs to trigger the auto-cure macro.
    • Increased cooldown of premium cure potions 2.5sec -> 2.7sec
    • "Notable" equipment changes:
      • Added separation in ranged weapons of a certain type: bow/crossbow and pistols/machine gun:
        • Applies only to the following weapon types: Leon, PVP, Crimson, Relic. (i.e., Leon crossbow, Leon pistols, PVP crossbow, PVP machine gun, Crimson crossbow, Crimson pistols have been added).
        • Bows and pistols have: increased damage spread (increased upper damage, reduced lower damage), crit. and dodge properties.
        • Crossbow and machine gun have: low damage spread, attack and HP properties. (The lower damage limit is additionally increased)
          • Crossbow and machine gun have minimal damage spread.
        • Added Leon support staff. Has lower damage than a regular Leon staff but has universal support and survival properties.
      • Changed all two-handed warrior Leon weapons. Changed properties and damage for increased diversity between Leon warrior weapons.
      • Changed properties of the Leon staff. Reduced attack properties, increased crit properties.

        • Added additional movement speed bonuses for the Accretia race
      • Added citadel support jewelry. Has universal support and survival properties.
      • Increased damage of type-B grenade launchers and throwing weapons.
      • Added the ability to craft Palmas and Council armor with level 53 armor stats.
      • Buffed phase 2 weapons (level 51-55).

  • "Guild Brawl" [More details at the link] - unique system on a permanent basis, with points awarded for game events.
  • Guild store for buying in-game items with guild points. [More details at the link]
  • Guild Development system with individual leveling of guild effects and skills. [More details at the link]
    • Added new "Guild PB" with unique loot "guild skill capsule" that temporary increase stats for guild characters. [More details at the link]
  • Guild Emblem item required to create a guild. Item obtained by combining x10 guild emblem fragments. Guild emblem fragments sold at the Hero for 5kk.
  • Added ability to block character sale (charshop) on the web-auction. [More details at the link]
    • Updated charshop block display. Block now shown in "Show current members" menu on the guild top page.
  • CP from GvG removed.
Locations and Mobs:
  • Elan location globally revised. New passages and zones added. Including "South Beach" with a fast path to PB Dagnue, "North Beach" with a fast path to PB Dagon, and much more.
  • Changed Lucky Cube spawn in BM. 10 cubes appear fixed every 2 hours (00:00, 02:00, 04:00 etc. Moscow time), spawn throughout the location, and have increased survivability.
  • Removed all cloned mobs in the HQ.
  • Added spot for non-quest BuildersAssasin in outposts: Anacaade (X:20 Y:25), Numerus (X:70 Y:50). Armory-117 (X:25 Y:52).
  • Volcano:
    • Revised burn ash spots. Burn ash spots now yield less experience (including exp dungeons).
    • Added new spots in Volcano:
      • Infernal demolis spot between North and West Abandon Cave Entrance.
      • Volcanic grumble and volite spot in Miasma Land (before BM transition).
      • Burn ash spot near West Abandon Cave Entrance (near infernal demolis spot).
      • Grumble owl spot in Cauldron center, between Evil Horn and Genial Spr zones.
      • Hobo assassin spot in Genial Spr.
      • Reduced hobo assassin spot near North Abandon Cave Entrance.
      • Added new single monster spots in various zones.
  • Elan:
    • Scud spot experience increased. Now significantly better than "Barrel" spot (including exp dungeons).
    • Significantly reduced respawn time for scud and boggie volt. Also slightly reduced scud and boggie volt experience (in total, leveling on these monsters became faster).
    • Visually changed "Beach" spot on elan to simplify tower leveling.
    • Added new spots in Elan (mobs scattered for convenient solo leveling or questing):
      • Draco spot on extra Citadel passage.
      • Level 58 robot spot on North Beach.
      • Level 59 robot and scud spot on North Beach.
      • Level 57 turncoat spot on South Beach.
      • Scud spot on South Beach.
      • Boggie volt spot on South Beach.
      • Turncoat spot in Elan Citadel (mobs not scattered).
  • DNA Decoder item required from merchant before Laboratory to enter. Resurrection in Laboratory on death.
  • Added new locations — Training Camp (location with exp mob copies for level 50+ characters), Desolation Wasteland (location for level 59+ character leveling), Desert of Hunters (location for Hunting Points farm for level 55+ characters). [More details at the link ]
    • Added daily event to Desert of Hunters. [More details at the link ]
  • Added additional ZI spots — 1 Naroom Fort in Threatening Passage instead of hellers spot, 2 Kukra Forts in twin valley.

  • Reduced damage for volcano, elan, part of BM, and high-level outpost mobs (excluding izens). Damage reduction is slight but allows more comfortable questing or solo leveling with gear of appropriate level.
  • Added new monster display type "Solo" (S icon). These monsters: 1) cannot be crit; 2) loot bonuses do not work on them; 3) loot drops on the ground (auto-loot does not work).
  • Removed skill Refresh from all mobs.
  • Revised Cartella Quest monsters.
    [More details at the link]
    • Trial Lunker respawn accelerated in Sette Desert.
    • Draco respawn accelerated on Elan.
    • Devastator Rhea respawn accelerated on Elan.
      • Added extra Devastator Rhea spot on elan — Devastator Rhea now spawn instead of devastators in Queer Wood.
    • Added new monsters "Elite Turncoasts". x3 Elite Turncoasts appear near race portals (but not right at portals) in Sette Desert.
    • Mutant Plant respawn accelerated in Laboratory.
      • Added extra Mutant Plant spot behind Ether Platform on the way to Jacks Lot on Ether.
    • Added monsters "Beast Mountain Devil". x2 Devils appear at Foggy Lake and x2 appear between Darkness Forest and Ancient Road in Beast Mountain.
    • Reworked respawn of monsters for hard Cartella quests. Now they spawn within one hour, every 2 hours.
    • Added new monsters heroic volts for hard group Cartella quests. Monsters spawn every 2 hours.
    • Added new Metal monsters.
      • Spider Invader Metal. Medium monsters with low damage and hp.
        • 3 Spiders respawn every 4 minutes near PB Tower Rift Metal, which exists for 10 minutes... 27 (9 per 10 minutes) Tower Rift Metals appear in Crag Mines randomly every 2 hours starting at 01:15, 01:25, 01:35 Moscow time (22:35 GMT, 05:35 WIB). (i.e., 9 towers appear at 01:15, 01:25, 01:35 \ 03:15, 03:25, 03:35 \ 05:15, 05:25, 05:35 \ 07:15, 07:25, 07:35 \ 09:15, 09:25, 09:35 \ 11:15, 11:25, 11:35 \ 13:15, 13:25, 13:35 \ 15:15, 15:25, 15:35 \ 17:15, 17:25, 17:35 \ 19:15, 19;25, 19:35 \ 21:15, 21:25, 21:35 \ 23:15, 23:25, 23:35 Moscow time (20:35 GMT, 03:35 WIB))
      • Chainsaw Invader Metal. PB with low HP.
        • 7 PB Chainsaw Invader Metals appear every 2min30sec and exist for 5 minutes... 77 (7 per 2min30sec) Chainsaw Invader Metals appear randomly in Crag Mine center at (12:35 - 13:00) and (20:35 - 21:00) Moscow time.
Start Quests:
  • Monster quantity for start quest completion reduced. Reward for start quest completion increased.
  • Start quests now have missions to kill mobs +8 levels higher (was +7) (encourages start quest completion without excessive exp loss compared to killing +10 level mobs).
  • Start HQ quests no longer award CP. CP in outside HQ start quests increased.
  • Revised standard level 35-44 quests for smoother character development.

  • Eased quests for level 31 and 35 type-B armor. Level limit changed, completion timer removed, quest chain changed in some cases.
    • Mob for level 35 type-B armor quest can no longer move.
    • Jade of Punishment (reduced attack) removed.
Quests:
  • Daily quests (cd 23h or 24h) have fixed reset at 09:00 Moscow time (06:00 GMT, 13:00 WIB).
  • Additional quest limit increased from 5 to 12.

  • Added new daily quest rewarding 10 temporary non-tradable chocolates (duration 5min.). [More details at the link]
  • Added new daily quest rewarding 2 temporary non-tradable chaos potions (duration 30min.). [More details at the link ]
  • Added new daily shop quests. Available rewards: XP, PvP points, CT, Hunting points. [More details at the link]
  • Added new daily and weekly personal guild experience quests. Reward: guild experience capsule (for passive skill leveling) and BD reward shards (for dungeon rewards). [More details at the link]
    • Actualized guild experience quests. PB quests removed, difficult monster quantity reduced, etc.
  • Added repeatable quests for increased dungeon rewards, purchasable for gold points.
  • Added daily quests for double rewards for completing certain dungeons. [More details at the link]
  • Solo BD Reward Quests:
    [More details at the link ]
    • New solo quests introduced yielding dungeon-like rewards.
      • Quests revised.
    • Shard quantity for solo quest completion and shards required for rewards revalued.
      • Completing different solo quests awards different shard quantities (4-7)
    • BD reward shards obtainable from other sources:
      • Double BD reward shard quest. [More details at the link]
      • Personal guild experience quests. [More details at the link ]
      • New Cartella Quests. [More details at the link]

  • Added new Cartella Quests for important resources and equipment. [More details at the link]
    • New daily quests with varied difficulties.
    • Reward list and quest emblems refresh every 2 weeks (Phase 1.1 emblems for first two weeks, 1.2 for next two, etc.).
    • Rewards revised. Added more personal equipment rewards.
    • Increased quest variety.
    • Added choice for hard quest — solo or group.

  • Added numerous new daily solo experience quests. Available from level 40, purchasable for race currency.
  • Revised group cash shop experience quests. Now at every level (from 35), a new daily quest is available that can be taken at that level and/or the next three. E.g., at level 39, you can take 4 daily group quests.

  • Added a new custom quest chain that begins in Phase 1 and ends in Phase 3. The rewards for completing the chain include personal "rank" relics, which can be obtained by completing this difficult quest chain.

  • Added new daily Traveler Quests.
    • Quests obtainable via Cactus Seed resource, which drops from cactus gathering resources.
    • Rewards include experience, significant CP, and various resources (random reward).
    • Three traveler quest difficulties. The higher your level, the higher the chance for a higher difficulty quest. Higher difficulty yields more CP and resources.

  • PvP Elan Quests:
    • PvP quest merchant on Elan moved to the merchant before PB Taraven.
    • Elan PvP quests revised; quantity reduced to 5, reward increased by 2 times. To complete item missions, you only need to bring seals directly (no excelsiar combination needed). [More details at the link]
Ore, Mining, etc.:
[More details at the link]
  • Mining available without HMS.
  • Module implemented for uniform mining speed at any mining point.
  • UMT battery speed depends on character level.
  • UMT battery gradation and price changed based on level.
  • UMT HP depends on character level. E.g., at level 40, UMT has 100,000 HP; at level 50, 225,000 HP.
  • Ore revalued by 5 times = Ore resource quantity increased by 5 times, processing price increased by 5 times, mining speed reduced by 5 times, available ore (mines, mobs, boxes) reduced by 5 times. [More details at the link]
    E.g., if previously mining for an hour yielded 5 stacks processed for 800k each (4kk total) for 2 talics per stack (10 total), you now mine 1 stack per hour, process for 4kk, and get 10 talics. Total currency cost and resources per hour remain the same, but processing is faster since only 1 stack is handled instead of 5.
  • Ore equipment crafting requires only one ore color.
  • Crafting resource quantities balanced between +1, +2, +3 ore.
  • T1 stones removed from ore processing.
  • Mining tool available from level 48.
  • Added +1 and +2 ore processing combination. [More details at the link]
  • Added CT crafting combination from keen talic (unavailable at start). [More details at the link]
  • Talic + catalyst combination removed.
  • Starting at Stage 1.2 (two weeks from start), HQ War times: Morning 40 min, Afternoon 60 min, Evening 80 min.
  • Starting from week 2, chat during HQ War will cost 1kk currency.
Turrets, Mines, Siege Kits:
  • Turrets now display: Deployment speed, damage, attack speed, current durability, max HP.
  • 45 turrets added to the merchant near Taraven on Elan.
  • Level 50+ turret survivability increased.
  • Added personal turrets for PvP points with accelerated deployment and repairability.
  • Added 55 relic turret repair combination. [More details at the link]
  • Auto-loot medal does not work on turrets up to level 50.
  • Added buffed PVE dungeon turret, instantly and nearly free only in dungeon locations. [More details at the link]
  • Siege kits sold at NPC Rare Tools.
  • Added new level 40 siege kit with modified property (10% attack), allowing use of 2 siege skills.
Runes, Generators, Teleports:
  • Available runes — Destruction (10min), Convert (5min), Swift (5min), Escape (30min), Defense (10min)(5min for Accretians).
  • Defense rune duration changed from 30s to 15s (30s to 10s for Accretians).
  • Attack and defense generators combined into one attack+defense generator.
  • Available generators: attack+defense, move speed, special pvp and hunting point generators, aggression.
    • Attack+defense, move speed, and aggression generators added to Foreign Vendor.
    • Middle Class and Beginner jewelry added to Foreign Vendor.
    • Teleports to VC, Elan, BM, OL, Desolation Wasteland, Desert of Hunters, and BM/OL entry stones added to Foreign Vendor.
Other Other:
  • NPCs for buff leveling added at outpost exits. Added debuff leveling location; teleport available at top HQ TP.
  • Added a new weekly global event "Battle for Ether". A unique automatic event where races will compete for a new race buff, and the strongest in the race will have a chance to prove themselves and become a hero of their race. [More details at the link]
  • New in-game events and activities added: rare resource gathering and rare monster hunting. [More details at the link]
  • New in-game event "Rifts" added, yielding x2 rewards from monsters in specific locations at specific times. (times changed) [More details at the link]
    • Leveling Spatial Rifts:
      • BaBa rifts (volcano) now appear 4 times a day and last 2 hours.
      • Along with BaBa Rift, a new additional leveling rift appears lasting 2 hours. New rifts:
        • Vulcano grumble
        • Vulcano ash
        • Vulcano curr
        • Vulcano granite block
        • Elan beach
        • Elan cave
        • Elan waterfall
        • Elan barrels
    • Resource Mystic Rifts:
      • Caliana rift, Ether (currency)
      • Gathering ore rift, Crag Mines (gold points)
      • Gathering cactus rift, Sette Desert (various resources)
  • Catching-up-system added. [More details at the link]
  • PVP system changed: [More details at the link]
    • PVP points gain in party added.
    • Max temporary PVP points during evening HQ War and temporary PVP point gain during evening HQ War (and other weekend wars) increased.
    • PVP points revalued by 10 times (max temporary points reduced by 10x, gain reduced by 10x, PVP merchant prices reduced by 10x).
  • CP for HQ War win increased to 7000. Spent CP recovery for HQ War win removed.
  • Paragon system for level 65+ characters. [More details at the link]
  • Ability to pack stacks (x99) of resources into boxes added (saves space by storing stacks in 1 slot as a box)(excludes farm resources).
  • ExcelSiar revalued by 10 times = Excelsiar drop from mobs reduced by 10 times, excelsiar quantity for combinations reduced by 10 times.
    • Whole excelsiar crafting changed; 100% whole excelsiar craft combination added. [More details at the link]
  • Looting in MAU allowed. No leveling in MAU.
  • Cure Potions (2.7s) added for race currency.
    • Accretia race Cure Potion (2.7s) delay reduced by 12% to 2.3s.
  • Cure Potions (4s) added for race currency.
  • Class redefine at Hero limited to 3 times.
  • Rare ore processing done directly via Gem Collector (no need for NPC Ore crystal exchange).
  • Different icons added for Outpost and Outside HQ teleport scrolls.
  • Ammo damage equalized to beam ammo.
  • Cash shop elemental bow ammo now usable with bow, crossbow, beam bow, beam crossbow.
  • PVP point trading (letting kill freely) strictly prohibited.
  • CP trading prohibited, except "I give you - you give me".
  • CP from GvG removed.
  • CP gain for killing characters in home locations (117, 213, Solus, Anakade, Haram, Numerus) removed.
  • Function added to store items previously un-storable in the bank (e.g., solo dungeon quest scrolls), but characters with these items cannot be put on web-auction. [More details at the link]
  • Numerous item descriptions updated and optimized.

TECHNICAL FEATURES:

  • Updated automatic online web-auction for selling/buying items, characters, or resources for cash shop coins, including between races. [More details at the link ]
    • Added ability to list resources: talics, ore resources, upgrade stones, leon parts, etc.
  • Withdraw Cash Shop -> real money. [More details at the link]
  • Guild store for buying in-game items with guild points. [More details at the link]
  • Guild Development system with individual leveling of guild effects and skills. [More details at the link]
    • Added new "Guild PB" with unique loot "guild skill capsule" that temporary increase stats for guild characters.
  • Minimized window "Alt-Tab" notification system implemented. Client icon flashes orange if: Character dies, PM received, HQ War starts.
  • Combinations are now instant, no tedious animation or extra waiting time.
  • Mass ore processing function added (multiple stacks at once).
  • Inventory interaction. Open bag can now:
    • Be locked from closing via ESC.
    • Be locked from moving.
    • Be locked from sorting.
  • Inventory sorting and reverse sorting available.
  • Modification window now shows all outcomes upon click and their chances (success, failure, talic removal, item destruction).
  • Lock from close and move added for:
    • Party list
    • Menu Macro
    • Main equipment window
  • Buffs and potions can be canceled by right-clicking.
  • Potions no longer expire on restart.
  • Removed pop-up window in center of screen upon entering / receiving dungeon mission.
  • Visual display for purse charger activation added. Purse chargers no longer turn off when changing weapons.
  • Keyboard mode available in MAU.
  • Run mode automatically applied when boarding MAU.
  • Megaphone item available; messages shown to all players.
  • Ability to paste (ctrl+v) text into any in-game chat.
  • Cure Potion added to macro menu. Flexible settings allow choosing specific debuffs for auto-cure.
  • Key-binds for all 5 panel lines can be configured. All 5 lines clickable via keyboard. Key-bind settings in client menu. Bind import/export "via key" available for instant setup/sharing.
  • "Endless" potions and dopings implemented.
  • Mass attack crit effect changed (works only on players). Anti-crit now calculated for each individual hit player. Previously projected from initial target.
  • Removed "system" miss on monsters. 5% miss chance for direct attacks disabled.
  • Mass attacks cannot be used on dead characters or characters under invulnerability (Defense Rune, Stone Curse).
  • Fixed daily quest reset module (23h and 24h quests) at 09:00 Moscow time (06:00 GMT, 13:00 WIB).
  • Additional quest limit increased from 5 to 12.
  • Mass attack crit effect changed (works only on players). Anti-crit calculated for each individual player.
  • Unique death screen with menu for fast revival potion use.
  • Auto-stack when opening boxes.
  • Buyback function for items sold to NPCs added.
  • Character movement possible when game window is minimized.
  • Fixed "phantoms" bug.
  • Fixed lag when attacking multiple monsters with certain DB weapons.
  • Unique Dodge, Accuracy, PrecisionAccuracy system. [More details at the link]
  • Auto-loot system-module.
  • Council voting system-module. [More details at the link]
  • Auto-kick system (active only when server limit reached and queue active). Kicks characters inactive for 20 minutes (except: Buff leveling, afk EXP gain (hunting), mining).
  • Systems tracking PVP and CP trading implemented.
  • Knowledge base with PB respawn, status (alive/dead), and killer (character/guild) info. [More details at the link]
  • Nicknames and Guild names only in English Letters.

  • Added function to launch "4GB" client (lower amount of crit. errors)
  • Launcher design and functionality updated. [More details at the link]
  • Queue system in launcher.
    • Queue priorities added. Priority given to recently "disconnected" users, race leaders (councils), and premium users.
  • Gateway system for minimum ping, with gateway selection.
    • New ExitLag connection improvement module added. Reduces ping and delay. Toggle via launcher settings.
  • Removed Fire Guard when entering.

topics.title: Важно - [Server information] Phase 1. Stages of 1st phase.
topics.bodyHtml:
General information - *link*
(all information not described in this thread can be found in the "General information" thread)
Technical guides - *link*
Full server description (currently available) - *link*

Detailed information of Phase 1 (level 50) -
Leveling -
Maximum level 50. Unsealing is unavailable.

> Catching-up system is available, which increases experience gained if you fall behind in level from the highest level characters on the server (the larger the difference between your level and the level of the highest character on the server [regardless of race] - the more bonus experience you receive). [More details at *link*]

> Leveling Methods:
  • Standard hunting on mobs in locations.
  • Additional "non-standard" monster spots:
    • Volcano:
      • Revised burn ash spots. Burn ash spots now yield less experience (including exp dungeons).
      • Added new spots in Volcano:
        • Infernal demolis spot between North and West Abandon Cave Entrance.
        • Volcanic grumble and volite spot in Miasma Land (before BM transition).
        • Burn ash spot near West Abandon Cave Entrance (near infernal demolis spot).
        • Grumble owl spot in Cauldron center, between Evil Horn and Genial Spr zones.
        • Hobo assassin spot in Genial Spr.
        • Reduced hobo assassin spot near North Abandon Cave Entrance.
        • Added new single monster spots in various zones.
      • Elan:
        • Scud spot experience increased. Now significantly better than "Barrel" spot (including exp dungeons).
        • Significantly reduced respawn time for scud and boggie volt. Also slightly reduced scud and boggie volt experience (in total, leveling on these monsters became faster).
        • Visually changed "Beach" spot on elan to simplify tower leveling.
        • Added new spots in Elan (mobs scattered for convenient solo leveling or questing):
          • Draco spot on extra Citadel passage.
          • Level 58 robot spot on North Beach.
          • Level 59 robot and scud spot on North Beach.
          • Level 57 turncoat spot on South Beach.
          • Scud spot on South Beach.
          • Boggie volt spot on South Beach.
    • Also part of non-standard leveling on mobs are EXP rifts, which spawn monsters with increased experience every 6 hours for two hours. [More details at *link*]
  • New special EXP dungeons (40+), which can be used to level up if there is no possibility to level up in locations [More details at *link*]
  • Leveling Quests:
    • Standard one-time quests (received upon reaching level)
    • Numerous daily* quests for experience (35+ for group, 40+ for solo): [More details at *link*]
      *all daily quests reset at 09:00 Moscow time (06:00 GMT, 13:00 WIB), regardless of when you completed the quest
> Additional sources of "simplified" leveling
  • Daily quest for 10 free bonus chocolates*. Quest can be taken: [More details at *link*]
    • At NPC Foreign Vendor in HQ from level 35+.
    • Can be obtained by completing Cartella Quests. [More details at *link*]
  • Daily group quest for 2 free bonus chaos potions*. Quest can be taken: [More details at *link*]
    • At NPC Foreign Vendor in HQ from level 40+.
    • Can be obtained by completing Cartella Quests. [More details at *link*]
  • Guild skills, increasing experience gain for all guild members. Guild experience is required to upgrade guild skills. [More details at link]
    • Experience boost potion for the whole guild for 3 hours. Dropped from new mini-Guild PB Experienced BaBa.
  • Potions:
    • Chocolate, increases experience gained by 33%:
      • Can be purchased in Cash Shop. [More details at *link*]
      • Can be obtained for completing daily quests and standard quests. (see above)
    • Expert Attack Potion (55% attack + 33% experience):
      *cannot be used together with chocolate
      • Can be purchased in Cash Shop. [More details at *link*]
      • Can be obtained from Cash Shop sets. [More details at *link*]
  • Catching-up system is available. (see above at the beginning of category)

"Non-standard" level bonuses -
  • Drop-level system, allowing higher level characters to farm more from farm mobs. [More details at *link*]
  • UMT batteries based on level. Increasing character level makes UMT batteries faster and more profitable. [More details at *link*]
  • UMT based on level. Increasing character level makes UMT "tougher" and more profitable. [More details at *link*]
  • Availability of medium and hard Cartella Quests. [More details at *link*]
  • Availability of experienced and elite adventurer quests. [More details at *link*]
  • Increased amount of guild experience from individual guild experience quests, as well as additional reward at level 50 - BD reward shards. [More details at *link*]

Farm -

> Main information:
  • Removed level penalty from all mobs on Ether, turncoats in Sette Desert, Lazhuwardians in Crag Mines and all mobs which are "gathering resources" [flowers, ore, cactuses].
  • Added drop-level system. The higher your level (starting from level 49), the more loot you get from mobs at farm locations. [More details at *link*]
  • Reduced farm from mobs at HQ and outside HQ zones.
  • ExcelSiar revalued by 10 times = Reduced drop of ExcelSiar from mobs by 10 times, and also reduced amount of ExcelSiar needed for combinations by 10 times.
Ether farm changes:

Revised farm on Ether, the entire location is divided into conditional "farm zones", based on profitability.
Spots are adjusted such that farm in them differs drastically.

The initial and weakest profit zone, let's call it "first" - these are the first robots at the exit of each wharf.
The second most profitable zone - the so-called "second" robots - Dam, Workshop, Graveyard, Necropolis.
The third zone - White Hole.
The fourth - Lures Lot.
And the most "delicious" farm zone on Ether - Jacks Lot.
Also added spots of elite calianas in robots spots of level 43-44

> Main sources of currency farm (from lowest to highest):
  • Mobs in outpost locations
  • Level 41 robots on Ether (near wharfs)
  • Turncoat mobs in Sette Desert
  • Level 43-44 robots on Ether
  • Level 45-46 robots on Ether (White Hole)
  • Mobs in Lures Lot
  • Elite caliana in spots of 43-44 robots on Ether (not available for first week)
  • Mobs in Jacks Lot (elite calianas not available for first week)
  • Caliana rift on Ether [More details at *link*] (not available for first week)
Also farm mobs include:
  • Gathering resource "frost flowers" on Ether. [More details at *link*]
  • Goblins in Volcano. (but level loot penalty applies to them)
Also Inventor's Accessories Box, Rare Ore, ExcelSiar are farmed from mobs.
Currency can be sold on web-auction via Gold bar box (sold at NPC Rare Tools). [More details at *link*]

> Additional sources of "simplified" farming
  • Guild skill, increasing drop rate for all guild members. Guild experience is required to level guild skills. [More details at link]
    • Drop rate increase potion for the whole guild for 3 hours. Dropped from new mini-Guild PB Lucky Lazhuardian.
  • Potions:
    • Loot increase potion, increases loot dropped by 50%.
      • Can be purchased in Cash Shop. [More details at *link*]
  • Drop-level system is available. (see above)

Resources (1/2) -
  • Resources (2/2) (all other resources) - regulated by stages.

CHOCOLATE AND CHAOS POTION QUESTS

"The Chocolate Factory" Quest
The daily quest "The Chocolate Factory" allows you to get Cash Shop Chocolate for free and with almost no cost.
Chocolate helps with character leveling for almost 2 hours every day.

Quest is available to characters level 35+ at the Foreign Vendor in HQ. Daily quest.
For completing the quest, you receive 10 pcs. of temporary Bonus Chocolate.
The duration of the Bonus Chocolate is 24 hours.


Group Quest "Chaos Alchemy"
The daily quest "Chaos Alchemy" is the perfect daily opportunity to obtain Chaos Potions at almost any available time. It is always a useful addition to any leveling party.

EXP QUESTS

New daily experience quests are available for character leveling at levels 35+.
Quests are taken from the EXP Quester in HQ. Solo quests require level 40+, group quests require level 35+.


Solo EXP Quests

Daily solo experience quests are available at level 40+. To take the quest, you must purchase an "Experience Quest Coupon" for racial currency.
At each level, several* solo experience quests are available, which can be taken simultaneously. Lower-level quests give less experience than higher-level quests.

Daily solo experience quests can be taken from the EXP Quester in HQ.

Other EXP Quests

Experience can also be obtained by completing the following quests:

  • Cartella quests (level 37+ [at server start])
  • Adventurer quests (level 42+ [at server start])
  • Elan quests (level 49+)
Information on all these quests can be found below.


CASH SHOP QUESTS

In the in-game Cash Shop, daily quests are available at a price of 333 Cash coins. For completing each quest, you can receive valuable materials and resources.

There are 4 Cash Shop quests available with the following rewards:
  • Experience quests, level limit 35+ (a new experience quest can be taken at each level);
  • Crystal Talic quest, level limit 50+;
  • PVP points quest, level limit 50+;
  • Hunting points quest, level limit 55+.
All quests are group and daily quests.


CARTELLA QUESTS

Cartella Quests is a separate large quest module, which you can read more about *at this link*.

Cartella quests are a set of daily quests with different difficulty levels. By completing them, you can obtain equipment, BD keys, relics, experience, and other valuable resources.

Cartella quests and the rewards from these quests are updated every stage.


ADVENTURER QUESTS

Adventurer Quests is a separate large quest module, which you can read more about *at this link*.

Adventurer quests are daily quests taken for the item "Cactus Seeds", which can be dropped from gathering cactuses. By completing Adventurer quests, you can obtain contribution points, experience, relic parchment, and various other resources.


SOLO BD QUESTS

Solo BD quests is a separate quest module, which you can read more about *at this link*.

Solo BD quests are cooldown-free / repeatable quests (not daily), by completing which you can receive rewards the same as for completing dungeons.

Solo BD quest rewards are updated every stage.


DUNGEON QUESTS

BD quests allow you to receive increased reward for completing certain dungeons.
BD quests can be obtained:
  • sold from PVP Reward Merchant
  • from gold points quest
  • from Cartella Quest Emblems
To complete the quest, you need to finish a specific dungeon. As a reward for completing the quest, you can receive a reward box of that dungeon.
Quests from the PVP merchant and Cartella emblems are daily quests. Gold points quests have no cooldown.

More details about gold points quests:
For gold points, you can purchase a quest where if you bring a BD key - you will receive x3 quests for that specific dungeon.
Gold quests have no cooldown.


GUILD QUESTS

Guild quests are unique tasks, for the completion of which a character receives "guild experience", which can then be spent to level up guild skills. More details - *link*.

General guild quest.

The progress of the general quest is counted for all guild members. You can view the progress of the quest in the guild skills leveling menu *at this link*.
For example, a guild was given the general quest "Kill 500 Caliana". To complete such a quest, all guild players will have to kill a total of 500 Calianas in a day. This could be 1 character who kills 500 Calianas, or 10 characters who kill 50 Calianas each.

There are two types of general quests: Daily and Weekly. One daily general quest is available per day, and one weekly quest is available per week.

If the Guild does not have time to complete the general quest, then upon expiration of the completion period, the quest will be updated and the Guild will receive a new task.


Individual guild quests.

Individual guild quests are completed by each player separately. You can obtain such a quest from the Main Guild Curator in HQ.

There are two types of individual quests: Daily and Weekly. A daily quest can be obtained once a day, and a weekly one — once a week. For completing the quest, the player receives a guild experience capsule, as well as BD reward shards.

The higher the character's level, the higher the value of the guild experience capsule for completing the quest.


ELAN QUESTS

Elan quests contribute to character development in both PVP points and experience. With the new updated quests, completing these tasks has become much more pleasant and profitable.

A total of 5 quests are available for daily completion, each performed in the Beast Mountain location.
Quests can be purchased for 7.5kk from the Quest Vendor on Elan (located near the Merchant, not far from PB Taraven).

For completing each quest, you receive 0.5% experience and 45 PVP points.
Quests are daily.

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Cartella Quests are important part of progression and one of the main ways to obtain equipment, dungeon keys, resources, and other valuable items.

QUESTS

Quests can be obtained from the NPC Cartella Assistant in HQ, next to NPC Gatekeeper.

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Adventurer Quests are daily quests, by completing which you receive experience, CP, relic parchment and other resources.
  • Adventurer Quests can be taken from the merchant in Sette Desert.
  • To take a random Adventurer Quest (a quest that subsequently opens the skilled and elite quest) it is necessary to have the
    "Cactus Seeds" item    .
    • Cactus seeds of the current stage drop from gathering cactuses.
    • Also Cactus Seeds trophy can be obtained from "desert remains" cactuses, which appear throughout Nadir Plain after the death of the Heroic Cactus.
      Heroic Cactus spawns in Nadir Plain at 12:10, 15:10, 21:10, 00:10 Moscow time (09:10, 12:10, 18:10, 21:10 GMT / 13:10, 16:10, 19:10, 01:10 WIB).
      If the heroic cactus was not killed within 30 minutes - the heroic cactus will disappear, but the desert remains will still appear.
    • Cactus seeds can also be listed and purchased on the web-auction.





​

 RANDOM ADVENTURER QUEST

Random adventurer quest is the initial quest in the adventurer's path. Quests can be taken starting from level 42 (at the server start).
The random quest is a solo, daily quest, by completing which you also receive the opportunity to complete skilled and elite adventurer quests.

There are several adventurer quest grades: low, medium, high.
The higher the quest grade - the more rewards you will receive for its completion. The quest grade cannot be chosen, however, the higher your level - the higher the chance that you will get a quest of a higher grade.

To take a random adventurer quest it is necessary to have the
"Cactus Seeds" item.

  • Contributetion Points

Skilled quest is the second quest in the adventurer's path, after the initial random adventurer quest. The quest can be taken from level 50.
Skilled quest is a partially-party, daily quest, by completing which you also receive the opportunity to complete the elite adventurer quest.

Skilled quest can only be taken after completing the random adventurer quest. Skilled quest has a chain of two quests.

Elite quest is the third quest in the adventurer's path, after the skilled adventurer quest. The quest can be taken from level 50.
Elite quest is a solo chain of 6 quests. Elite quest can be taken only once per stage.

Elite quest can be taken only after completing the skilled quest 4 times during the current stage.

topics.title: [Server information] Global Event - Battle for Ether
topics.bodyHtml:
The new global event Battle for Ether creates new points of conflict and unique rewards, regardless of whether you are a solo player, or a player in a party, or a member of a guild and race - everyone will be able to contribute and receive rewards for the Battle for Ether.

GENERAL INFORMATION
  • Battle for Ether takes place in the Ether location.
  • The event takes place once a week, on Sunday at 20:00 Moscow time (17:00 GMT, 23:59 WIB). The event duration is 1 hour.
  • During the event, the loot drop from farm mobs is reduced
    there is no farm reduction during OBT

REWARDS

Racial buff
For participating in the event, each character receives passive bonuses: increased drop rate and damage against monsters. The higher the race's rank in the event, the stronger the racial buff effect. The bonus lasts until the next event, specifically for the entire week! Do not miss the event so as not to be left without the bonus for all 7 days.
  • Race 1st place: 15% drop + 6% PVE damage
  • Race 2nd place: 10% drop + 4% PVE damage
  • Race 3rd place: 5% drop + 2% PVE damage
The bonus can be found in the relics menu under the "Technical" section.


Race Hero buff
In each race, at the end of the event, three race heroes assigned. Race Hero status is granted to characters who have the top 3 points at the end of the event in their race. Race Heroes receive a unique aura and a bonus of 10% overall damage and 10% MAU damage for the entire following week.

While holding the Race Hero buff, it is impossible to list the character on the auction via charshop.

The bonus can be found in the relics menu under the "Technical" section.

Racial currency and Gold Points
Racial currency and gold points drop from all event monsters (except pillars). Loot increase potions do not affect this. For the terminal, the loot is shared by everyone, regardless of who landed the last hit or dealt the most damage.


POINTS AND RATING

For killing event monsters and completing objectives, characters receive personal event points. All personal event points are summed up into race points.

At the end of the event, races take first, second, or third place, depending on which race has more race points. The higher the race's rank, the stronger their racial buff for the entire following week.
The top 3 characters with the highest points in their race also receive the Race Hero bonus for the entire following week.


Rating points (current points of each race and personal character points) are displayed in a separate menu, which is visible only while on Ether during the event. The rating table updates every 30 seconds. If a character is outside the Ether location, they do not receive personal points.
  • Points for Pit Bosses in a party are granted to party members only if they were near the Pit Boss at the moment of the PB's death.
  • Points for Pillars are granted to the party regardless of where the characters are in the Ether location, but at the moment of killing the Pillar, the party members must be near the pillar, otherwise passive point calculation will not work.

MONSTERS AND OBJECTIVES

The Battle for Ether event has 4 types of monsters and objectives. Solo turncoat monsters, group Pit Boss conquerors, pillars for races and guilds, and terminal for everyone.
Event monsters exist only when the Battle for Ether is active.


Solo monsters - Turncoats

  • Race turncoats constantly appear in the Ether Platform zone, and have weak stats so that almost any level 50 character can farm them.
  • Monsters have random and fast spawns; staying to farm in one spot will not work, you need to constantly move in search of turncoats.
  • For killing a turncoat, a character receives 1 event point (does not work for a party).
    the point is counted for the one who had loot rights (by damage)
  • Also, racial currency and gold points drop from turncoats.
    loot increase potions do not work

Group monsters - Conquerors

  • Conquerors Pit Bosses appear randomly throughout the entire Ether location. They spawn constantly throughout the event.
  • When a Pit Boss is killed, all party members who participated in the kill receive event points. Party members must be near the PB at the moment of death to receive points.
    • Points are awarded to the party that has loot rights to this PB (by damage).
  • There are three types of conqueror monsters: Curr Conqueror (1st grade), Golem Conqueror (2nd grade), Guardian Conqueror (3rd grade).
    • The higher the grade of the Pit Boss, the more points it brings to the party and the more racial currency and gold point it drops.
  • Curr conquerors appear frequently on the main roads of Ether.
    • When a Curr is killed, each character in the party receives 4 points.
      Although Curr PBs are Pit Bosses, they do not appear on the PB scanner.
  • Golem conquerors appear infrequently, mostly on the outskirts of zones.
    • When a Golem is killed, each character in the party receives 22 points.
  • Guardian conquerors appear most rarely in the between pillars zones.
    • When a Guardian is killed, each character in the party receives 45 points.

Pillars

  • The Battle for Ether has unique control points - Pillars.
  • When a pillar is killed, the party that killed it gains control over that pillar, and the pillar fully restores its health after capture.
    • If another party kills this pillar, the previous party will lose control, and the new party that captured it will gain control.
    • When a pillar is killed, a notification appears in the chat stating which pillar was captured and by whom.
    • Control of the pillar is granted to the character/party that landed the last hit.
  • The pillar constantly (every 30 seconds) brings 4-6 event points to all characters in the party that controls it, regardless of where the party members are, meaning it is not necessary to be near the pillar to continuously receive control points.
    • But AT THE MOMENT OF KILLING the Pillar, party members must be near the pillar, otherwise passive point calculation will not work.
  • There are 6 pillars in total. Pillar locations:
    • 1) Lockout wharf
    • 2) Graveyard
    • 3) Lemon yard
    • 4) Lures lot
    • 5) Jacks lot
    • 6) Bell. repairs
  • For each race (specifically the race of the party controlling it), the pillar has its own unique appearance.

Terminal

  • The Terminal is located in the center of Ether and has no affiliation with any race; it is hostile to all races and is a major objective in the Battle for Ether event.
  • The Terminal is an objective for the entire race and has a very high amount of HP. It requires many characters and time to destroy it.
    • The Terminal does not respawn after destruction.
  • Destroying the terminal awards a large number of race points (not to be confused with personal points), which are divided proportionally among all races based on how much damage the race dealt to the terminal.
    • A total of 22,000 race points are awarded. The percentage ratio is calculated by damage to the terminal; for example, if the Bellato race dealt 50% damage, the Cora race dealt 30% damage, and the Accretia race dealt 20% damage, the Bellato race will receive 11,000 race points, the Cora race will receive 6,600 race points, and the Accretia race will receive 4,400 race points.
  • Additionally, the top three characters of each race by damage to the terminal receive 375 event points. (Regardless of how much damage their race or another race dealt in total, even if you were the only representative of your race who hit the terminal once, you will receive 375 points because you entered the "top 3" damage to the terminal from your race).
  • When the terminal is destroyed, racial currency coupons and gold points drop from it; the loot is for everyone, regardless of who landed the last hit or dealt the damage.

Recycling relics:

Sealed Relic Parts also have grades. Recycling a Grade 1 relic gives a Grade 1 Sealed Relic Part, recycling a Grade 2 relic gives a Grade 2 Sealed Relic Part, and so on.



x3 Sealed Relic Parts of the same grade can be combined into one Random Relic Box of that grade (90%) or a random relic box of the next grade (10%) (not tradable).



Also, Sealed Relic Parts can be recycled into relic dust, which is used for upgrading relics (see below).

Relics can be upgraded to +1, +2, +3, improving their stats. Relics are upgraded linearly (first +0 to +1, then +1 to +2, then +2 to +3). If an upgrade fails, the relic DOES NOT decrease its current upgrade level.

Bonus from relic upgrade:
  • +1 = stats increase by 20%
  • +2 = stats increase by 50%
  • +3 = stats increase by 100%
Relic upgrade chance:
  • +1 = success chance 50%
  • +2 = success chance 25%
  • +3 = success chance 12%
Exceptions: Gift of Random Goddess Relic and event relics Can't be upgraded .

To upgrade relics, the resource Relic Parchment is required.
  • There are 6 grades of parchment, corresponding to relic grades. Relic Parchment is not tradable (parchment boxes that drop from PB are tradable).

Progress for the general quest is counted for all guild members. You can view quest progress in the guild skill leveling menu *at this link*.

  • Reward: 400 guild experience for the general weekly quest.

2. Individual Guild Quests.

Individual guild quests are completed by each player separately. You can obtain this quest from the Main Guild Curator in HQ.

There are two types of individual quests: Daily and Weekly. A daily quest can be obtained once a day, and a weekly one — once a week. For completing the quest, the player receives a guild experience capsule, as well as BD reward shards.

For weekly quests, the limit is also 50 individual guild quests. The limit resets every Monday at 00:00 Moscow time (21:00 GMT, 04:00 WIB).


GUILD PBS

Guild Pit Bosses are special PBs that drop capsules for temporary improvement of guild skills.
All temporary guild skill capsules last for 3 hours.

Available Guild PBs:
All guild PBs have a respawn time of 6 hours.
  • Experienced Baba. Location — Cauldron center, drop — Temporary guild EXP increase capsule ("guild EXP potion") +15% EXP.
  • (starting from 2nd week of Stage 1.1) Lucky Lazhuardian. Location — Crag Mines center, drop — Temporary guild drop increase capsule ("guild luck potion") +20% drop.
  • (starting from Stage 1.2) Builder Upsilon. Location — Outposts, drop — Temporary guild attack increase capsule ("guild attack potion") +N% attack.
    • Spawn location in Armory 213 — Death Valley, coordinates: 25 43.
    • Spawn location in Solus — Crawler Wood, coordinates: 63 57.
    • Spawn location in Haram — Crimson Coast, coordinates: 80 43.
  • (starting from 2nd week of Stage 1.2). Builder Omicron. Location — Ether Platform, drop — Temporary guild attack increase capsule ("guild attack potion") +N% attack and Temporary guild HP increase capsule ("guild HP potion") +N% HP.
  • (starting from Stage 1.3) Shaman Desert Traveler. Location — Sette Desert Center, drop — Temporary guild HP increase capsule +N% HP and Temporary guild absorb increase capsule +N% absorb.
  • (starting from Stage 2.1) Swamp Klan. Location — GC, drop — Temporary guild crit. increase capsule +N crit. and Temporary guild HP increase capsule +N% HP.
  • (starting from Stage 3.1) Naroom Renegade. Location — OL, drop — Temporary guild absorb increase capsule +N% absorb and Temporary guild attack increase capsule +N% attack.

Guild skill boosting works on a "+ effect amount" logic, not "+ skill level," and does not depend on the current guild skill level.
Using multiple identical capsules does not stack the effect or duration. Reusing an identical capsule will result in it being wasted.

For example, the drop bonus from a guild skill is:
  • Level 1 — 1%;
  • Level 2 — 2%;
  • Level 3 — 3%;
  • Level 4 — 5%;
  • Level 5 — 7%;
  • Level 6 — 10%;
  • Level 7 — 14%;
  • Level 8 — 19%;
  • Level 9 — 24%;
  • Level 10 — 30%.
Example 1.
A guild has leveled the drop bonus skill to Level 6, which gives a 10% drop bonus. Then the guild uses a temporary guild skill improvement capsule for +15% drop. As a result, the guild receives a 25% drop bonus: 10% from the Level 6 skill + 15% from the temporary capsule.
When the temporary capsule effect expires, the guild will only have the 10% drop bonus from the Level 6 skill.

Example 2.
A guild has leveled the drop bonus skill to Level 10, which gives a 30% drop bonus. Then the guild uses a temporary guild skill improvement capsule for +15% drop. As a result, the guild receives a 45% drop bonus: 30% from the Level 10 skill + 15% from the temporary capsule.
When the temporary capsule effect expires, the guild will only have the 30% drop bonus from the Level 10 skill.

Example 3.
A guild has Level 0 for the drop bonus skill, so the guild receives no drop bonus. Then the guild uses a temporary guild skill improvement capsule for +15% drop. As a result, the guild receives a 15% drop bonus.
When the temporary capsule effect expires, the guild will have a 0% drop bonus from the Level 0 skill.

topics.bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

GENERAL INFORMATION
  • Gathering resources is a new in-game activity for any type of player, where anyone, at almost any level and in any equipment, can obtain valuable rewards simply by carefully inspecting specific locations and gathering (destroying) resources.
  • Gathering resources appear at absolutely random points in the location, which makes it impossible to farm these resources while staying "in one spot". It is necessary to constantly move and look for resources in different places (within the location).
  • In one location, there are 3 grades of gathering resources of the same type: Grade 1 - very common and has a reduced reward, Grade 2 - rare and has a significant average reward, Grade 3 - incredibly rare and insanely valuable.
  • Gathering resources have random spawn times and a random spawn chance. On average, per hour in one location, there appear: 500 Grade 1 resources, 50 Grade 2, and 0.33 Grade 3.
    • Due to absolute randomness, there may appear either half as many or twice as many resources per hour; average values are indicated.
    • provided that the resources are being farmed by someone; if nobody is killing them, the maximum number that can be on the map is 80 resources.
  • The drop from gathering resources is not 100%, you can use loot increase potions to improve the chances of loot.

Frozen Flowers:

Located on Ether, drop currency.

Auto-loot medal information:

The auto-loot medal is a unique module that allows you not to waste precious time picking up loot from the floor.
  • If you are without a party, but with a medal, the loot drops immediately into the inventory.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'Shared' - all loot drops on the ground.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'On the leader' and the leader with a medal, the loot drops into the leader inventory.
    • If the loot is in the group 'On the leader', but he does not have a medal, the loot falls to the ground, but belongs to the leader.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'Queue' - the loot drops in queue, if a player without a medal is 1st in the queue, the loot drops on the ground, but belongs to that party member who was in queue. To all party members with a medal, loot drops into the inventory on their queue.
    • If the party member, whose turn it is to receive loot, is in a far distance, the loot drops on the ground.

  • The medal disappears as soon as the Premium Service period ends.
  • The medal does not work on any loot from Pit Bosses.
  • If you want to disable autoloot, just sell the medal to NPC. When you re-enter the game, the medal will automatically return to the inventory.

Getting temporary PVP points for killing characters, depending on the level:
  • Gain temporary PVP points starts at 45 level.
  • No temporary PVP points are awarded for killing characters of level 44 and below.

  • If a group member in your group has received temporary PVP points for killing a character, you will also receive +temporary PVP points, if they were in the radius (near the group) of receiving PVP points.

topics.title: [Server information] Level Drop System
topics.bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

The drop-level system allows high-level characters to farm more from farm mobs* than characters at a lower level.
*farm mobs = mobs on ether, turncoasts in sette desert, some event mobs (if indicated).

In the realities of current farming, where a "good equiped" character of level 45 can farm one spot "for respawn"*, the drop-level system provides an opportunity for characters above the level to farm more, thereby encouraging character leveling, motivating to have a higher level in order to have more farming in the future.
*"for respawn" = kill all monsters on the spot before they appear, thereby 100% farming the spot.

The drop-level system is configured for each phase separately.
